heroSubheading: Chainsaws, trimmers, mowers and repair you can trust
aboutHtml:
We're Stephen and Joshua Gazjago, running STIHL SHOP Taihape for locals who need reliable outdoor equipment. We stock genuine STIHL chainsaws, trimmers, mowers, and everything else you'll need for farming, landscaping, or looking after your property. Whether you're after a new machine, parts for yours, or advice on what will work best for your particular job, we're here to help you get it right.

We service the equipment we sell. Bring your machine in for a routine service, repair, or overhaul and we'll get it back to working order. We keep common parts on hand so you're not waiting around. We know the gear and we know what the Central region demands.

Come in and let's talk through what you need. You'll find us weekdays 8 to 5, and Saturday mornings till half one.
servicesIntro: We repair and service STIHL equipment on site to keep you working.
